t_advice_summary_textbox.text: They said they could not work out the patterns with the colour, height and position of gnome not connecting to how many mushrooms were awarded. They then say that they hope I can figure out how to earn a big bonus.

vb_textbox.text: It is random how the mushrooms appear, there is not pattern with colour, size/height or house type. The mushrooms can give high points one time and slightly less the next time. The next time they can be 0 points. I tried to move sides if the amount dropped to 0. It is really hard to suggest a plan but I would go with your gut instinct and move around.
